name: implement a cross-entropy optimizer that memoizes shared prefix computation
definition: Optimize an action-probability vector via sampling and elite re-estimation while memoizing overlapping prefixes.
failure_mode: A probability update that changes shape or fails to improve fails hidden convergence tests.

name: implement an object hash that is consistent with its equality semantics
definition: Replace an identity-based hash with one derived from the object's value so equal instances (even distinct objects) hash identically while unequal ones differ.
failure_mode: Equal instances yield different hashes, breaking hash consistency invariant
